_about: The New chat page at /chat, and the chat entries in the left sidebar.
_greetingsAbout: Picked by the clock on the viewer's computer. Morning from 5am, afternoon from 12pm, evening from 5pm until 5am.
_greetingNameAbout: The name in the greeting. Set here on its own, so it does not follow the signed-in teammate in src/data/teammates.js.
_skillsAbout: The / button in the chat box, which opens the skills picker. The picker's own words are in content/skills/library.json.
_suggestionsAbout: The chips under the composer. Clicking one sends it as the first message of a new chat.
